network_independent: SAC addresses are derived from the asset definition via CAP-46-3 (Env::deployer().with_stellar_asset(xdr).deployed_address()), so they are the same on every network for these asset definitions.
pool_ordering_policy: token_0 is always native XLM; token_1 is always Circle USDC. Reversed or unknown pairs are rejected at initialization (ENFORCED on-chain).
identity_proof: The pool identity proof is derived-address pinning: the supplied SAC address must equal the address derived on-chain from the reviewed asset definition. symbol/name/decimals are defense-in-depth only, never the proof. A tampered/upgraded implementation still living at the pinned address is caught by the post-deploy transfer/allowance canary (verify_token_compatibility), required before the first deposit.

canary.activation_gate: add_liquidity refuses the first deposit (Error::CanaryNotCompleted) until the canary passes
canary.notes: Proves approve / transfer_from / transfer work end-to-end for each pool token with a strict round trip; catches fee-on-transfer, silently dropped/partial transfers, and broken authorization.
